answer: Each Sybil node must lock collateral C scaled super-linearly as C_i = k i^2 and accept quadratic slashing s_i = k i^2 on attack, so a cluster of m nodes commits ∑i^2 = m(m+1)/2 units, exceeding extracted value V = v m once k m^2/2 > v m, i.e. m > 2v/k. At the security summit, the quill encodes this threshold, and the meadow of liquidity sinks makes marginal cost exceed marginal gain.
